title: Pronoun swap
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: pronoun swap)
intro: Lesson 18: Personal pronouns: we, you all, they. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Sentences
points: هُمْ فِي المَسْجِدِ: they are in the masjid

questions.q: Say: they are in the masjid.
Pronoun swap on the pupil PDF: rewrite six sentences changing the pronoun (e.g. هُوَ فِي البَيْتِ → هُمْ فِي البَيْتِ), then write two sentences about your class with نَحْنُ.
questions.a: Correct swaps; e.g. نَحْنُ طُلَّابٌ، نَحْنُ فِي الفَصْلِ

questions.q: Stretch: find the pronoun in يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا and who it addresses.

questions.a: A) نَحْنُ فِي الفَصْلِ. نَحْنُ = we.

questions.q: Think again: who does يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا talk to?
